title: DAFX: Digital Audio Effects (Udo Zölzer)
summary: Academic reference for digital audio effects with theoretical foundations.
description:
## Overview

DAFX is the definitive academic reference for digital audio effects, covering the mathematical and theoretical foundations of DSP.

## Key Topics

| Part | Topic |
|------|-------|
| I | Filters and equalization |
| II | Pitch and time modification |
| III | Dynamics processing |
| IV | Spatial effects |
| V | Reverb and spatialization |

## Relevant For

- Theoretical foundation for all DSP effects
- Filter design theory
- Spatial audio processing
- Modulation effects theory

## Citation

Zölzer, Udo (Ed.). *DAFX: Digital Audio Effects*. Wiley, 2011.

## Why Important

Academic rigor and comprehensive coverage of DSP theory beyond implementation.
